What's new in EnigmaCast

You can now play catch-up from the TV guide, and set a reminder or AutoSwitch for a programme that has not started yet. Record IPTV now, or schedule a recording from the guide, to the TV's internal storage or a USB drive. For Xtream accounts, Settings shows whether the subscription is active, when it expires, and how many connections are in use. Each IPTV provider can have its own user-agent and extra HTTP headers. You can choose how often the playlist is refreshed: every 6, 12, 24 or 48 hours, or only when you refresh it yourself. Moving right in the TV guide now correctly reaches programmes that have not started yet.

companion.notes: Live koppelt nu automatisch met de Enigma2-ontvanger van de TV. Nieuw: Zoeken en een Torrents-tab als die op de TV aanstaat.
